title: Cross-Layer Censorship Event Database
description: A curated catalog of crypto censorship events (OFAC SDN, DOJ, SEC/CFTC, nation-state, corporate, supranational) tracked across six independent layers — network (L0), consensus (L1), RPC (L3), frontend (L4), asset on-chain, and off-ramp CEX — with hour-precision timelines and multi-source-verified evidence. Admission requires one primary source or two independent semi-primary sources per layer-level observation; every web citation carries a Wayback URL and a sha256 body_hash anchor for reproducibility. Released under an open schema so other researchers can extend the catalog.
